purpose: Prepare D.4.3 after user-authorized development closure of stage2: static spatial energy, physical boundaries/reservoirs, charge conservation/potential, the thesis three-state circuit, then weak dynamics and localized synthetic deposition. No stage3 implementation or calculation in this delivery.

circuit_override.topology: Thesis4.16 voltage bias, Rbias/Lbias, detector branch, coupling capacitor and readout load.
circuit_override.passive_convention: For left-to-right total detector current Is, Vdev=phi_L-phi_R; Is*Vdev enters the resolved-domain energy. Transform historical current and voltage signs together per CM.5.
circuit_override.inductance_partition: The series Lk,ext represents only unresolved exterior storage. Historical10nH is a total reference; identify a positive exterior partition before a coupled run and do not subtract a time-varying hotspot inductance.
circuit_override.full_balance: CM.9, including source Vbias*Ib, bias/load resistor losses, capacitor and both exterior inductive stores, escape and reservoir flux/work.

current_stage2_snapshot.candidate: 630 complementary electronic states,1025 phonon nodes,guarded SSP method in its recorded scenarios
current_stage2_snapshot.unresolved: Three-mesh dynamic certification and all final configuration-specific checks not reached by the interrupted batch remain incomplete. No automatic full-batch restart.
current_stage2_snapshot.scope_rule: Development closure enables the next registered work, not a universal numerical certificate. Scoped passes, failures and uncertainty are retained; stage3 must assess the quantities it actually uses.

field_scope.limitation: Amplitude-motion energy bookkeeping does not certify spectral work from varying Gamma(q) or electrical port work.

entry_requirements.requires: Use the user-authorized development closure and preserve the incomplete stage2 numerical certificate as an explicit limitation. Do not require its boolean numerical_admission as a global workflow gate.
Before each experiment, record geometry, field/population representation, units, support, source/input hashes, parameters, initial and boundary conditions, references and exclusions.

Same energy for forces/current; passive electrical ports; physical occupations and finite states; conservative exchange without clipping, extrapolation or energy repair; admit spatial evolution only where D.36 is certified.
entry_requirements.prior_criteria_scope: Preserve previous verdicts under their original thresholds. Their complete numerical campaign is not a universal prerequisite for every new static or exploratory experiment.

entry_requirements.requires: Define the physical difference to distinguish, observable scales/norms, reference uncertainty and applicable spatial/temporal/spectral error budgets before results. Quantitative acceptance is scoped to those observables.
Estimate pilot cost before launch; no expected computation over5minutes by the agent. This delivery prepares only, with no stage3 implementation or launch.

preserved_inputs.material_scope: Traceable synthetic Debye inputs may be used for numerical tests; NbN absolute rates and detector latency require separate material admission.
preserved_inputs.history: Preserve failed methods and meshes. No clipping, hidden extrapolation, energy repair or removal of failed evidence.

first_bounded_work.name: Static discrete spatial energy, Cartesian derivatives, current and spatial admissibility

geometry.type: One-dimensional longitudinal diagnostic strip with uniform cross-section
geometry.provenance: Dimensions of the resolved thesis reference segment; the1D diagnostic reduction and periodic closure are new proposals, not a reproduction of physical device boundaries.

boundary_conditions.diagnostic: Periodic amplitude and populations with prescribed phase twist Delta(L)=exp(i*q0*L)*Delta(0); begin q0=0, then registered weak q0 within certified support.
boundary_conditions.replacement: Step3B replaces this diagnostic closure with open terminals/reservoirs, continuations, insulating walls and2D-1D interfaces.

first_bounded_work.populations: Prepare thermal and nonthermal bounded populations, then hold fixed state occupations in variations of the internal energy. Any fixed-temperature free-energy check is a separately identified derivative.
scenarios: Smooth amplitude modulation at fixed physical wavelength
Smooth phase modulation at fixed physical wavelength
Admitted phase-flow variations that explicitly change Gamma=hbar*D*|q_delta|^2/2
to_fix_before_run: Observable error scales and numerical budgets
observables: Current conjugate to phase/field variations of the complete spatial energy, including gradient terms and spectral Gamma dependence
first_bounded_work.reference: Uniform R2 limit plus independent variation/linearization of the same continuous functional; distinguish spectral/table error from spatial error. A1D result cannot certify every direction of2D.
expected_outputs: Admitted sampled domain and retained rejection cases
Decision on proceeding to physical-boundary step3B

draft_spatial_acceptance.policy: Choose precision prospectively from the physical difference and observable to resolve, with reference uncertainty and relevant spatial/time/spectral/table contributions. Do not choose a new threshold merely to pass prior failed data.
draft_spatial_acceptance.error_scales: Record units, absolute scales near zero, relative errors where meaningful and the denominator before evaluation. Avoid hiding exchange errors behind a large background energy.
draft_spatial_acceptance.algebraic_checks: Use independent algebra/derivatives and differentiation-step checks at precision sufficient to detect sign/factor/duplicate-energy errors; do not equate numerical identities with device accuracy.
draft_spatial_acceptance.refinement: Compare the same physical profile on the proposed grids. Explain observed error changes using discretization and reference uncertainty; extend only if needed to resolve the registered decision.
draft_spatial_acceptance.principal_symbol: Require a certified positive minimum eigenvalue for evolution in the declared geometry, with uncertainty smaller than its margin. Nonpositive or uncertifiable values reject that state; no rigidity clipping.

mandatory_negative_control.expected: Identify the documented spatially unstable state and reject it for evolution; retain its diagnostic result.

draft_spatial_acceptance.failed_precision_policy: Preserve the failure and quantify its effect on the intended conclusion; do not automatically stop work independent of that observable. Structural physical/domain failures stop the affected calculation.
draft_spatial_acceptance.stage2_benchmark_warning: 320steps over normalized time0-2 describes the stage2 benchmark only; it does not fix the spatial PDE timestep or circuit coupling interval.
draft_spatial_acceptance.varying_flow_requirement: Register an admitted varying-Gamma(q_delta) test with fixed occupations, full-energy forces/current and spectral work. The prior fixed-Gamma amplitude test does not satisfy this check.

execution_policy.long_work: Record purpose, exact command, fresh output path, estimated runtime and resources; wait for user execution. Do not retry or split a timed-out calculation to evade handoff.

conclusion_limit: Development handoff is prepared after scoped stage2 closure. No stage3 code or calculation in this delivery; no unmeasured mesh PASS, absolute NbN prediction, detector threshold/latency or production admission. Effective-core validation belongs to D.4.4; complete detector transients and production decisions to D.4.5.

static_stage3a_scope.allowed_scope: Small static spatial energy, Cartesian derivatives and current at fixed physical populations.

does_not_infer: PASS for the historical failed supplementary pair
Physical fidelity of the effective core
Absolute NbN material rates or latency
development_entry.continuation_rule: Implement later in the sequence below, with prospective experiment-specific registration and relevant checks. A structural defect stops the affected calculation; insufficient precision keeps its verdict and limits the claim without automatically blocking unrelated work.

implementation_sequence.name: Funcional espacial estático
implementation_sequence.work: Derive Cartesian forces and current from the same discrete energy on the small fixed-population strip. Check uniform and weak-gradient limits, support and D.36.
implementation_sequence.acceptance_scope: Static sampled configurations only; compare registered observables with independent references.

implementation_sequence.name: Bordes, interfaces y reservorios
implementation_sequence.work: Use insulating walls,2D-1D matching and remote reservoirs from D.24-D.27. Begin at zero current and then weak admitted current; explicitly account for face measures, electronic flux and reservoir work.
observables: Change in central observables as continuations grow

implementation_sequence.name: Conservación de carga y potencial
implementation_sequence.work: Solve D.22 with the same superconducting current and normal current, declared passive terminal signs and one potential reference. No extra charge-accumulation dynamics. Check a controlled varying-flow path at fixed occupations: spectral-level work from Gamma(q_delta) and full-functional forces/current must reproduce its energy change; this is a new spatial/electrical check, not a repeated stage2 run.
observables: Energy change versus spectral and full-functional work on a controlled varying-Gamma path

implementation_sequence.name: Circuito de la memoria de tres estados
implementation_sequence.work: Couple CM.4 for Ib,Is,vc after identifying the positive exterior inductance and passive Vdev. Check CM.10 fixed point, prescribed-input reference, CM.8-CM.9 and temporal resolution of the field/circuit exchange.
implementation_sequence.reference_scope: Synthetic prescribed-resistance circuit diagnostic; not a resolved detector transient or identification of the thesis total10nH partition.

implementation_sequence.name: Dinámica débil y depósito local
implementation_sequence.work: Begin with a small perturbation without photon, then register a localized D.30/CM.11 deposition within supported and spatially admissible states. Assess observable-specific spatial/time/spectral uncertainty and all energy exchanges.
observables: Device/node/capacitor/load voltages at common physical times
implementation_sequence.scope: Exploratory trajectories and their registered numerical accuracy; no automatic material, detection or production admission.
